text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Full of nutrition! Full of justice! 
Carotene charge, Carrotman!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Nutritional Warrior Carrotman." He's the 
hero of my favorite tokusatsu TV show!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
The suit is carrot-colored! Transforming 
in a flash, dashing coolly through the 
city of skyscrapers, the forest, and 
across the green turf...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "Carrotman is my dream. My hero. And—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: This is... where my "roots" are—!

text_block_list.name: Unhealthy Empire Executive
text_block_list.text:
"Mwahaha! You walked right into my trap, 
Carrotman! Get him, minions!"

text_block_list.name: Greasy Gang
text_block_list.text: "SKREEEEEECH!!"

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Kuh! It was a trap?! My nutrients are 
already...! Uwaaaahhhh!"

text_block_list.name: Young Biko
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh—! Carrot Maaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Biko's Father
text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Pega? Why the long face?

text_block_list.name: Young Biko
text_block_list.text:
Hey... is Carrotman weak...? He's always 
losing after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That depends on your definition of 
strength. Pega, what do you think 'true 
strength' is?

text_block_list.name: Young Biko
text_block_list.text: True... strength?

text_block_list.name: Biko's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Oh? It's time for Carrotman. Now 
then, last time ended on a huge pinch, so 
I wonder what'll happen?

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"No way, as if I'd let myself be beaten! I 
have comrades who support me, and someone 
I want to protect!"

text_block_list.name: Carrotman
text_block_list.text:
"Seven times down, eight times up—I'll 
never give in! Hyaaaahhh!"

text_block_list.name: Unhealthy Empire Executive
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Young Biko
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! He did it! Carrotman saved the 
town--!!

text_block_list.name: Young Biko
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even if you lose, even if you 
fail, you will definitely win in the end! 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Young Biko
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman isn't weak. He's super 
strong!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko's Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha...! Well, Dad's gotta head off to 
the night shift at the police box. Be a 
good girl today too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Carrotman always loses at first. That's 
why he's not super popular with kids, 
but..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Always stand back up without giving up! 
And in the end, smash through any 
hardship...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"When I was a runt of a kid who always 
lost whenever I tried to test my strength 
against other Umamusume, Carrotman gave me 
courage!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—From today on, the days of taking on the 
Twinkle Series together with Biko Pegasus 
begin.”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant, wheeeeze*! Hyah!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Warm-up complete! Let's get right 
into training!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Toyaaaaaah!! Pegasus Mach Slasher!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her dream is to "win races and become a 
hero like Carrotman."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, it won't be easy. She has a few 
major weaknesses. First of all—"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *pant*, *gasp*... Trainer, I'm 
out of energy... I can't stay active on 
Earth for very long.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have much stamina, so her 
aptitude is for sprint distances, around 
1,200m to 1,600m. In that case, she should 
just do her best in sprints, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Grrr...! I can't... break out to 
the front?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Many Umamusume in the sprint division are 
heavily muscled. With Biko Pegasus's small 
frame, she's inevitably at a 
disadvantage...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Plus, her preferred racing style is 
charging from the back. So in the final 
stretch, she can't win unless she finds a 
way past the wall of muscle in front of 
her.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I might be small, and maybe I'm still weak 
right now. But...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I'm de-finitely gonna become one! 
Someday, I'll be a hero who's 'stronger 
than anyone else'!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm totally not there yet, as long 
as I don't give up, I'll make it one day, 
right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Biko Pegasus possesses this 
positive spirit and the explosive burst to 
break through in an instant.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make the most of that and turn 
her into the absolute strongest hero no 
matter what.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Phewwwwww! Ran my heart out today too...! 
Nothing beats running on green turf, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Before I met Trainer, I ran on dirt all 
the time, but turf really feels way more 
like Carrotman after all!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Biko-chaaan! Great job on your 
training~!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who arrived was Hishi Akebono. 
She's Biko Pegasus's roommate in the 
dorms, yokozuna-sized, and an Umamusume 
who absolutely loves cooking.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You came to cheer for me? Hehehe! I did 
some super intense training today too, ya 
know!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Run like whoooosh, and then 
da-da-da-dash—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrroooowl~)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard that my tummy is 
completely empty!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I knew it! I had a feeling that'd 
happen~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, I wanted Biko-chan to eat well, 
so I made a buonissimo dinner~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ooh, really?! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I made a whole bunch, so let's eat 
together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~! This hot pot is so tasty~! It's 
packed with corn! And sausages too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Novelty hot pots are so buono~♪ Plus, 
this hot pot is known only to true 
connoisseurs...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ah! I get it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"It's the 'Healthy Kids' Carrot Butter Hot 
Pot' from episode 67 of Carrotman!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Corr~ect! Just as expected~. After all, 
Biko-chan knows everything there is to 
know about Carrotman♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Carrotman is my idol... and my 
goal!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
As the hero 'Justice Biko', I'm gonna be 
just like Carrotman!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think so too! Biko-chan is suuuper 
strong!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I bet you'll become a hero in no time in 
the Twinkle Series too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wait, not that I have much room to talk 
when my debut isn't even in sight yet~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"On the flip side, chasing after her back 
really drives it home for me. Just how 
incredible Biko-chan truly is...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ehehehe! Thanks, you two!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Go, go! Justice Biko~ Hooray, hooray! 
Justice Bikooooo~â"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Power is surging through me~~~! 
Seconds, please--!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The racing world is fiercely competitive. 
Having friends who cheer her on will 
surely continue to be a great source of 
support moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Phewww, that was delicious~! I ended up 
having two whole bowls of rice!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I ate so much, maybe I'll grow taller 
tomorrow...!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I don't know if she'll grow as big as she 
hopes. Even with a small body, with the 
right guidance, she can definitely become 
a hero."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Let's do our best, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I'm counting on you! Let's 
become the strongest superheroes together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, aiming to become the strongest 
hero of all, Biko Pegasus's challenge 
began.
